snippet.title: BORING GAMEPLAY VIDEO for AHatEftHL:XVII:tRR
snippet.description:
(If you want a not-boring video about the game, watch THE NEW TRAILER: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lLlUbXmmPoU)

I'm submitting Angry Henry And The Escape From The Helicopter Lords: Part 17: The Re-Reckoning (http://angryhenryandtheescapefromthehelicopterlordspart17.com) to a competition, and they asked for a video that explains the gameplay.

There's no way to make a video not be boring, so I didn't really try.
